rationale: The agent did authenticate the user (name + ZIP) and accessed the user’s orders, and it initiated exchanges on two laptops. However, it violated key policy requirements: it performed order-changing writes (two exchange_delivered_order_items calls and charged a stored credit card) without first confirming details with the user; it did not explicitly present or confirm the total amount due before executing the exchanges; and it did not provide the final total to the user in its closing message. It also selected a payment method without user confirmation. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with the policy and final information was not correctly communicated.
